title: The Sky Opened Wide
traveler_why: Scout is the Traveler who stops and looks, and tonight Ezekiel, far from home by a river, does not hurry past the opened sky but bows low with wonder at the rainbow round the light.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because a seeker’s whole heart opens wide when he sees something wonderful. In Scout’s world today: the rain stopped and a rainbow bent over the yard. Scout pressed his nose to the cold window and stood so still he forgot to blink. Then he ran and tugged Mom’s hand to come and see. Just like Ezekiel bowing low by the river, Scout learned that wonder is a quiet way of loving Heavenly Father.
